name: Transaction List
description: Provides access to the Transaction List report from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: date_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on payment method.

parameters.name: duedate_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range of due dates for balances to include in the report; otherwise, use the start_duedate and end_duedate to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: bothamount
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified transaction amount. For example, bothamount=1233.45 limits report contents to transactions of amount 1233.45.

parameters.name: transaction_type
parameters.description: Filters report contents based transaction type.

parameters.name: docnum
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified transaction number, as found in the docnum parameter of the transaction object.

parameters.name: start_moddate
parameters.description: (Account List Detail) Specify an explicit account modification report date range, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use the moddate_macro to cover a standard report date range.

parameters.name: source_account_type
parameters.description: Account type from which transactions are included in the report.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: The field in the transaction by which to group results.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. Supported Values: One or more comma separated department IDs as returned in the attribute, Department.Id of the Department object response code.

parameters.name: start_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: account_name*, create_by, create_date, cust_msg, due_date, doc_num*, inv_date, is_ap_paid, is_cleared, is_no_post*, last_mod_by, memo*, name*, other_account*, pmt_mthd, printed, sales_cust1, sales_cust2, sales_cust3, term_name, tracking_num, tx_date*, txn_type*, is_adj, last_mod_date, ship_via, olb_status, extra_doc_num, is_ar_paid. Additional columns when location tracking enabled: dept_name*.

parameters.name: end_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Supported Values: One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: memo
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified memo. Supported Values: One or more comma separated memo IDs.

parameters.name: appaid
parameters.description: Status of the balance.

parameters.name: moddate_macro
parameters.description: Predefined report account modification date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range when accounts were modified; otherwise, use the start_moddate and end_moddate to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: printed
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on whether checks are printed or not.

parameters.name: createdate_macro
parameters.description: Predefined report account create date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard create report date range; otherwise, use start_createdate and end_createdate to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: cleared
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified check status. Cleared: processed by a bank or credit card account and reflected in the bank balance. Uncleared: not reconciled or matched with bank statement records. Reconciled: compared to original records and verified as correct. Deposited: a deposit was made into a bank account.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified customers. Supported Values: One or more comma separated customer IDs as returned in the attribute, Customer.Id, of the Customer object response code.

parameters.name: qzurl
parameters.description: Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report. Quick Zoom URL is a hyperlink to another report containing further details about the particular column of data.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on term or terms supplied. Supported Values: One or more comma separated term IDs as returned in the attribute, Term.Id of the Term object response code.

parameters.name: end_createdate
parameters.description: Specify an explicit account create report date range, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use createdate_macro to cover a standard report date range. (This field is not currently available.)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on the specified comma separated list of ids for the name list customer, vendor, or employee objects. Query the Customer, Vendor, or Employee name list resource to determine the list of objects for this reference. Specify values found in Customer.Id, Vendor.Id, and Employee.Id. For example, name=1,4,7 includes data in the report for namelist ids 1, 4, and 7.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The column type used in sorting report rows. Specify a column type as defined with the columns query parameter.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: The sort order.

parameters.name: start_createdate
parameters.description: Specify an explicit account create report date range, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use createdate_macro to cover a standard report date range. (This field is not currently available.)

parameters.name: end_moddate
parameters.description: (Account List Detail) Specify an explicit account modification report date range, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use the moddate_macro to cover a standard report date range.
